description: Agent Labor Verification: submit a wage payment record with the verified hours and the agreed rates: the wage record with its reference, the worker, currency, the first and last day of the pay period, the pay date, the due date, regular, overtime and other pay, gross, net, the amount actually paid and each deduction with its item, amount and stated basis; the hours with their reference, period and the verified regular and overtime hours; the rates with their currency, the agreed hourly rate, the overtime rate or the overtime premium. The signed report gives the wage record, the hours and the rates, regular pay against the verified hours times the agreed rate, gross against its parts and net against gross less deductions, overtime pay against the overtime hours times the overtime rate, each deduction read for its stated basis, and the pay date and the amount paid against the due date and the net, and counts them, and names a divergent wage record: pay that does not recompute from hours and rate, the overtime premium missing from the pay, a deduction with no stated basis, and a pay period paid late or short; then another pay period and another currency, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No pay beside its hours and rate, no overtime rate beside overtime hours, or no due date or amount paid leaves those points unverified. Amounts compare to the cent in one currency and dates by the day; no tax or wage rule is supplied by the check. This reads pay for work already done against the hours and rates it should answer to: wever_bookkeeping-payroll-check reads a payroll register against its ledger postings, and wever_hire-payment-check reads the payment terms set up at hiring, while the labor wage check reads one wage payment against the verified hours and agreed rates. Verdict labor_wage_divergent, labor_wage_partial, labor_wage_unverified or labor_wage_consistent. POST /api/labor-wage-check. Reads the labor records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads the records as supplied only: it never schedules or assigns work, never pays wages, never hires, disciplines or terminates anyone and gives no legal advice, which stay with the employer, the worker and their advisers, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Labor Verification reads labor records for work already performed: a timesheet, a work-completion log, the licenses a worker held, an overtime claim, billed labor rates, billed labor hours, worker classification evidence and a wage record, each against the shift record, the agreed task list, the dates worked, the hours record, the rate card, the contracted labor scope, the classification claimed or the verified hours and agreed rates it answers to. The family checks hours, work, credentials and pay after the work is done; the Agent Hiring family checks decisions and documents before engagement. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-labor-verification-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-labor-verification/.

basis.description: Its stated basis, such as the plan election or a court order.

item.description: The deduction, such as Health plan.

due_on.description: The day the wages were due.

other_pay.description: Other pay, such as a bonus.

paid_amount.description: The amount actually paid on the pay date.

pay_date.description: The day the wages were paid.

period_end.description: The last day of the pay period.

period_start.description: The first day of the pay period.
